title: Polly
description: Polly is a resilience and transient-fault-handling library for .NET. It provides retry, circuit breaker, timeout, fallback, and bulkhead isolation policies to make distributed systems more robust.

data.text: Polly is a .NET library that implements resilience patterns. Instead of writing complex retry and error-handling logic manually, you compose policies that automatically handle transient failures like network drops, timeouts, and 500 errors.

data.title: Retry and Circuit Breaker
data.content: Wrap an HTTP call with retry and circuit breaker policies.

terms.definition: Automatically re-executes an operation after a transient failure.
Stops calling an operation after a threshold of failures, giving the downstream service time to recover.
A reusable rule that defines how to handle failures.

data.title: Combine Policies
data.text: Use Policy.WrapAsync() to compose multiple policies. A common stack is Retry + CircuitBreaker + Timeout.

Polly v8 replaced the policy-building syntax with a `ResiliencePipelineBuilder`, where strategies are added in order and compose automatically. Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience builds the same pipeline on top of `IHttpClientFactory`, so a resilient `HttpClient` is a one-line registration rather than hand-wired policy composition.

data.title: A resilience pipeline and the HttpClient shortcut
Interview angle: retry must be idempotent and bounded
data.text: Retrying a `POST` that is not idempotent can create duplicate orders, so retry only safe operations or use an idempotency key. Retries must also be bounded and backed off with jitter; unbounded retries turn one slow dependency into a retry storm that takes down the whole system. The circuit breaker is what stops that: once the failure ratio crosses the threshold, calls fail fast so the downstream service can recover instead of being hammered.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Polly turns brittle HTTP calls into resilient operations with minimal code.

data.title: Exercise: Add Retry to an API Call
data.description: Wrap a flaky API call with a Polly retry policy.
steps: Create a method that calls https://httpstat.us/500 (returns 500)
Add a retry policy that waits 2, 4, and 8 seconds between retries
Observe the total number of attempts and the final outcome
data.expectedOutcome: The app retries the failing call three times before surfacing the error.
